event.title: Event
event.description: What makes the booth this evening's booth: the welcome screen, and the texts printed on the photos.

slideshow.title: Idle slideshow
slideshow.description: The evening's photos on the welcome screen while nobody is using the booth.

timing.title: Screen delays
timing.description: How long the booth waits for a guest. A screen nobody answers goes back to the welcome screen on its own, so the next guest never finds the previous one's session.

capture.title: Taking photos
capture.description: Countdown, filters, which camera is used, and blurred borders around images.

print.title: Printing
print.description: The printer, and how many prints guests can ask for.

phones.title: Guest phones
phones.description: What guests can do from their own phone: get their photo, or send one to the booth to print it.

guest_network.title: Guest network (QR codes)
guest_network.description: What the QR codes on the booth carry, so a phone reaches it without anyone typing. The booth does not create this WiFi network: it only describes it.

screen.title: Screen and hardware
screen.description: Language, size and orientation of the screen, and the ring light.

storage.title: Storage and USB drive
storage.description: Where photos are saved, and the safeguards against a full disk.

access.title: Access, network and logs
access.description: The password for these pages, the web server address, and how long logs are kept.

dslr_liveview.title: DSLR: during preview
dslr_liveview.description: Settings sent to a DSLR (gphoto2 only) while the preview is shown. "Leave unchanged" keeps whatever is set on the camera.

dslr_capture.title: DSLR: when shooting
dslr_capture.description: Settings sent to the DSLR right before each photo. "Leave unchanged" keeps whatever is set on the camera.

WELCOME_TITLE.label: Welcome title
WELCOME_TITLE.help: The big words on the welcome screen. A whole sentence fits: it breaks between words into lines of even length and takes all the room there is. Leave empty to keep "Photo Booth". The photo behind it is changed just above.

WELCOME_SUBTITLE.label: Welcome subtitle
WELCOME_SUBTITLE.help: A line under the title, such as the names and the date. Leave empty for none.

WELCOME_FONT.label: Welcome lettering
WELCOME_FONT.help: The typeface of the title and subtitle. The handwritten one reads better in lower case than in capitals.

EVENT_NAME.label: Event name
EVENT_NAME.help: Printed wherever a template text says {event} (template editor). It is not shown anywhere else.

DATE_FORMAT.label: Date format
DATE_FORMAT.help: How {date} prints on templates: %d day, %m month, %Y year, %y two-digit year. For example %d/%m/%Y gives 14/09/2026. {time} always prints as hours:minutes.

SLIDESHOW.label: Slideshow when idle
SLIDESHOW.help: Shows the evening's collages, newest first. A touch brings the welcome screen back without starting a session. Only starts once a first photo exists.

SLIDESHOW_IDLE_SECONDS.label: Start the slideshow after
SLIDESHOW_IDLE_SECONDS.help: Time without any touch on the welcome screen before the slideshow starts. At least 10 seconds.

SLIDESHOW_PHOTO_SECONDS.label: Time per photo
SLIDESHOW_PHOTO_SECONDS.help: How long each collage stays before the next. At least 2 seconds.

COUNTDOWN.label: Countdown
COUNTDOWN.help: Seconds between the guest's press and the photo. 0 shoots at once.

FILTERS.label: Photo filters
FILTERS.help: Offers guests a choice of filters (black and white, sepia, vintage...) on the review screen, before printing.

CAMERA.label: Camera
CAMERA.help: "Detect automatically" tries every kind of camera at startup, which is slower. Naming the right one makes startup faster and predictable. "Fake" simulates a camera to test without hardware.

CALIBRATION.label: Preview / photo calibration
CALIBRATION.help: Only when the preview and the photo come from two different cameras (say a Pi camera for the preview and a DSLR for the photo): crops the preview to match the final photo. Format (zoom, offset_x, offset_y), produced by tools/calibrate_zoom.py. Leave empty to disable.

BLUR_CAMERA.label: Blurred borders around the preview
BLUR_CAMERA.help: Fills the empty bands around the live preview with a blurred copy of the image instead of plain bands.

PREVIEW_BLUR_REFRESH_FRAMES.label: Preview blur refresh
PREVIEW_BLUR_REFRESH_FRAMES.help: The blur above is only recomputed every N frames, to spare the CPU. 1 = every frame (smoothest, heaviest); 3 suits a Raspberry Pi. No effect when preview borders are off.

BLUR_IMAGES.label: Blurred borders around each photo
BLUR_IMAGES.help: Same effect on the screen showing each photo right after it is taken.

BLUR_COLLAGE.label: Blurred borders around the collage
BLUR_COLLAGE.help: Same effect on the review screen showing the final collage. Does not affect prints.

PRINTER.label: Printer name
PRINTER.help: The printer's name in CUPS (shown by lpstat -p). Leave empty to disable printing entirely.

MAX_PRINTS.label: Maximum prints
MAX_PRINTS.help: Total prints allowed, such as what the paper roll holds. Once reached, the booth stops printing. Leave empty for unlimited. The counter restarts from zero with "Delete all photos".

MAX_COPIES.label: Maximum copies per print
MAX_COPIES.help: Sheets a guest can ask for at once (10 at most). A template that duplicates its collage puts two photos on each sheet. 1 hides the copies selector.

COLLAGE_DPI.label: Collage resolution
COLLAGE_DPI.help: Templates are drawn at 300 dpi, the printer's own resolution, so 600 dpi does not change the print. It makes the collage sharper in the gallery and on guests' phones, but files are about four times larger and the collage takes a little longer to build.

PRINTER_WAIT_TIMEOUT.label: Wait when the printer stops answering
PRINTER_WAIT_TIMEOUT.help: When the printer is unplugged or in error, how long the booth waits for it to come back before giving up the print (the photo stays saved). At least 5 seconds.

SHARE.label: "Get my photo" button
SHARE.help: Adds a button on the review screen whose QR code takes the guest to their own photo, to download on their phone. The phone must be able to reach the booth: see "Guest network".

LANGUAGE.label: Language
LANGUAGE.help: Language of the booth screen and of these admin pages. Pages guests open on their own phone follow the phone's language.

FULLSCREEN.label: Fullscreen
FULLSCREEN.help: Runs the booth fullscreen, with no window or taskbar. Untick only to test on a computer.

WINDOW_WIDTH.label: Screen width
WINDOW_WIDTH.help: The screen's native resolution: 1024 x 600 for the Ingcool 7" touchscreen, 1920 x 1080 for a full HD monitor. Also used in fullscreen.

WINDOW_HEIGHT.label: Screen height
WINDOW_HEIGHT.help: See the width. For a turned screen, do not swap width and height: use the rotation.

ROTATION.label: Screen rotation
ROTATION.help: For a screen mounted on its side: the booth turns its display and touch input itself. Keep width and height at the native resolution. On Windows, leave at "None": the display is clipped there.

RINGLED.label: LED ring light
RINGLED.help: Drives the WS2812 LED ring wired to the Raspberry Pi SPI port. Leave unticked without that hardware.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.label: Admin password
ADMIN_PASSWORD.help: Protects these pages. At least 10 characters and not a common password (admin, 1234...), otherwise the admin area stays closed. Leaving it blank keeps the current one; typing None closes the admin area.

RINGLED_PIXELS.label: LEDs on the ring
RINGLED_PIXELS.help: How many LEDs the ring light has, so the animations go all the way round. 12 for the ring the booth is built with.

REMOTE_CAPTURE.label: Photos sent from phones
REMOTE_CAPTURE.help: Shows a QR code on the welcome screen: the guest takes a photo with their phone, sends it to the booth, then comes to print it. Received photos are moderated in "Phone photos".

REMOTE_MAX_UPLOAD_MB.label: Largest photo accepted
REMOTE_MAX_UPLOAD_MB.help: Anything larger is refused. The page already shrinks the photo on the phone before sending, so this is rarely reached.

REMOTE_MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS.label: Longest side kept
REMOTE_MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS.help: Received photos are shrunk to this size. Above the print resolution there is nothing to gain and a disk to fill. At least 640.

REMOTE_MAX_PER_SENDER.label: Waiting photos per phone
REMOTE_MAX_PER_SENDER.help: How many photos one phone may leave waiting to be printed, so one guest cannot fill the queue alone.

REMOTE_MAX_PENDING.label: Waiting photos in total
REMOTE_MAX_PENDING.help: Largest size of the queue, all phones together.

REMOTE_MIN_UPLOAD_INTERVAL.label: Delay between two sends
REMOTE_MIN_UPLOAD_INTERVAL.help: Minimum time a phone must wait between two sends. 0 for none.

REMOTE_URL.label: Booth address in QR codes
REMOTE_URL.help: Leave empty: the booth finds its own address, which is right when it has a single connection. Fill it in when it has several (cable and WiFi), sits behind a port forward, or has a fixed name. Full address, port included.

WIFI_SSID.label: Guest WiFi name
WIFI_SSID.help: The network guests join to reach the booth (travel router, venue WiFi...). A first QR code joins it without typing. Leave empty when guests are on it already: only the page code is shown.

WIFI_PASSWORD.label: WiFi password
WIFI_PASSWORD.help: Put in the QR code, so guests can see it. Leave empty for an open network.

WIFI_HIDDEN.label: Hidden network
WIFI_HIDDEN.help: Tick only if this WiFi does not broadcast its name.

DCIM_DIRECTORY.label: Photo folder
DCIM_DIRECTORY.help: Where sessions (photos and collages) are saved. Relative to the booth folder, or absolute (such as /media/photos).

DISK_MIN_FREE_GB.label: Minimum free space
DISK_MIN_FREE_GB.help: Below this, the booth refuses new sessions rather than failing in the middle of one.

DISK_MAX_USED_PERCENT.label: Maximum disk usage
DISK_MAX_USED_PERCENT.help: The same safeguard, as a percentage of the disk in use. 100 turns it off.

USB_EXPORT.label: Copy to USB drive
USB_EXPORT.help: Copies saved sessions to a USB drive as soon as one is plugged into the booth.

USB_MIN_FREE_GB.label: Minimum free space on the drive
USB_MIN_FREE_GB.help: The copy is refused when the drive has less free space than this.

WEB_PORT.label: Web server port
WEB_PORT.help: The port of the gallery, the admin and the send-a-photo page (http://booth-address:5000). QR codes follow it automatically.

WEB_HOST.label: Web server listen address
WEB_HOST.help: 0.0.0.0: reachable from every network the booth is on. 127.0.0.1: only from the booth itself (phones can no longer reach it). A specific address: one network only.

LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.label: Keep logs for
LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.help: Older logs are deleted at every start.

LOG_MAX_FILES.label: Maximum log files
LOG_MAX_FILES.help: Beyond this, the oldest are deleted at every start.

SHUTTERSPEED.label: Shutter speed
SHUTTERSPEED.help: In fractions of a second. 1/125 freezes ordinary movement; faster darkens the image.

APERTURE.label: Aperture (f/)
APERTURE.help: Small number: more light, blurred background. Large number: everything sharp, but more light needed (a flash).

FOCUSMODE.label: Focus mode
FOCUSMODE.help: One Shot (Canon) or AF-S (Nikon): focuses once before each photo. AF-C: continuous tracking. Manual: no autofocus.

ISO.label: ISO sensitivity
ISO.help: Higher: brighter image but more grain. 100 to 400 with a flash.

AUTO_KEEP_SECONDS.label: Keep the photo on its own after
AUTO_KEEP_SECONDS.help: After each shot, the photo is kept on its own after this delay, unless the guest asks to retake it. The ring around the confirm button shows the time left.

COUNTDOWN_IDLE_SECONDS.label: Back to welcome: waiting for the shot
COUNTDOWN_IDLE_SECONDS.help: When nobody presses to take the next photo, the session is abandoned and the booth goes back to the welcome screen.

SELECT_FORMAT_IDLE_SECONDS.label: Back to welcome: format choice
SELECT_FORMAT_IDLE_SECONDS.help: When nobody picks a format, the booth goes back to the welcome screen.

REVIEW_IDLE_SECONDS.label: Back to welcome: final screen
REVIEW_IDLE_SECONDS.help: When nobody prints or leaves the screen showing the final collage, the booth goes back to the welcome screen without printing.

PHONE_PHOTOS_IDLE_SECONDS.label: Back to welcome: phone photos
PHONE_PHOTOS_IDLE_SECONDS.help: When nobody picks one of the photos phones sent, the booth goes back to the welcome screen. Longer than the others: guests browse photos there.

ERROR_IDLE_SECONDS.label: Back to welcome: error
ERROR_IDLE_SECONDS.help: For an error a guest can continue past (a failed print, say). An error that needs an operator stays on screen.

QR_CODES_IDLE_SECONDS.label: QR codes close after
QR_CODES_IDLE_SECONDS.help: The QR codes on the welcome screen close on their own after this delay. Long enough to scan two codes and join the WiFi. At least 10 seconds.

PRINT_SCREEN_MIN_SECONDS.label: Shortest printing screen
PRINT_SCREEN_MIN_SECONDS.help: The printing screen stays at least this long, so the guest reads where to collect the photo, even when the printer answers at once. A touch skips it.

CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.label: Longest capture
CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.help: A safety net: a capture taking longer than this is treated as stuck, and the camera is reset. Raise it only for a camera known to be slow. At least 3 seconds.

PRINT_SHEET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.label: Longest print, per sheet
PRINT_SHEET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.help: A safety net: a print taking longer than this per sheet is reported as failed. A dye-sublimation printer often takes a minute a sheet. At least 30 seconds.
